title: Cozy Room Portfolio
summary: This site: a pixel-art 3D room where the monitor is the portfolio.
problem: Portfolios all look the same; I wanted one that shows 3D and front-end skills by being one.
solution: React Three Fiber scene built from code, pixelated post-processing, an HTML mini-OS inside the monitor, zod-validated JSON content.
result: Adding a project = adding a JSON file and pushing; GitHub Actions rebuilds and deploys.
